purpose: Conservative 12 mm steel-marble contact priors for an untreated FDM-printed PLA maze, used until quality-gated tests on the actual print replace them.

known_unmodeled_effects: directional friction from top-skin extrusion lines
centimeter-scale friction variation from seams and surface texture
session drift from dust, wear, temperature, and polishing

rolling_friction_length_m.derivation: dimensionless rolling resistance multiplied by the 0.006 m ball radius

modeling_notes: MuJoCo torsional and rolling friction parameters have units of length.
The simulation enables condim=6 so torsional and rolling friction are active.
Ranges are deliberately broad and are training distributions, not claimed measurements.
The current simulator samples a spatially uniform surface per episode; directional texture, local rough patches, and wear drift remain documented model gaps.
A quality-gated identified_dynamics.json overrides fitted rolling, damping, and restitution values.
